edits.description: Targeted edits, applied in this order. A later edit sees the result of the earlier ones.

artifact.description: Which file of the molecule this edit changes.

op.description: replace: swap an exact block. append: add at the end of the file. create: write a file that does not exist yet.

find.description: Required by replace: the exact current text, copied verbatim with its whitespace. It must occur EXACTLY ONCE in the file — if it occurs twice the edit is rejected, so extend it until it is unique. Omit for append and create.

content.description: The replacement text, the appended block, or the whole file on create.

why.description: One short line, in the user's language, saying what this edit does. It becomes the summary the user reads.
